# Creek Ocean Construction

> Creek Ocean Construction is a general contractor in Dartmouth, Nova Scotia, serving all of Halifax Regional Municipality (HRM). We provide general contracting, commercial renovations, custom millwork and cabinetry built in our own workshop, custom carpentry, and residential renovations. Licensed and insured, COR safety certified, WCB coverage.

## Contact
- Address: 79 Thorne Avenue, Dartmouth, NS B3B 0A4, Canada
- Phone: 902-405-0525
- General email: admin@creek.construction
- Careers email: career@creek.construction
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Atlantic Time. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61555688853587
- LinkedIn: https://ca.linkedin.com/company/creekoceanconstruction

## Services
- General contracting and commercial renovations: offices, retail spaces, restaurants, salons, hospitality projects, and other commercial environments
- Custom millwork and cabinetry: kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, built-in storage, entertainment units, reception desks, shelving, and commercial cabinetry, from fabrication to installation
- Custom carpentry: trim and finishing, custom wood features, shelving, doors and frames, and built-ins
- Residential renovations: kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, drywall, ceilings, finishes, and cabinetry, from single rooms to larger transformations

## Key facts
- Service area: all of HRM, including Halifax, Dartmouth, Bedford, Sackville, and surrounding communities. Creek does not currently take projects outside HRM.
- Warranty: 1 year on workmanship and labour; materials covered by the manufacturer's warranty.
- Creek handles required permits and can work from its own design or from a designer's or architect's plans.
- No open positions at this time; resumes for future opportunities go to career@creek.construction.
- Featured projects: Alton Flex Co-Working Space, Halifax Shopping Centre, NSLC The Port, Banook Boat Club, Dalhousie University The Grawood.
- Sister company: KP Glass & Aluminum (commercial glass, glazing, aluminum, automatic doors): https://kp-glass.ca/

Jeff Boudreau, Senior Property Manager | Groupe MACH
